context: arXiv:2603.27412 reports abliterated variants at AUROC at most 0.015 below their instruction-tuned counterparts; arXiv:2604.18901 reports matching within 0.003 over 12 models in 4 families, with a Gemma-3 exception where AUROC drops 0.057 while TPR collapses 0.751 -> 0.175. That exception is exactly why TPR at low FPR is primary here and a bare AUROC is not.
